notes:
WHAT I RETURNED. The `holes` array is the CURRENT, post-renovation card: par and stroke index for all 18, and per-hole yardage for the Brown (championship) tee. OUT 36/3,430 — IN 36/3,457 — TOTAL 72/6,887. Every arithmetic check passes (nine totals and grand total reconcile; the stroke index uses all of 1–18 exactly once).

PER-HOLE YARDAGE FOR THE OTHER TEES IS NOT PUBLISHED ANYWHERE. White, White/Black, Black and Gold exist only as totals with ratings/slopes. I did not interpolate them. If you need them, the pro shop (620-276-1210) is the only route.

THE COURSE HAS BEEN RENOVATED AND PARTLY RE-ROUTED — THIS IS THE BIG ONE. A 2021–2026 renovation (architects Zach Varty and Todd Clark, supt. Clay Payne, ~$700k, three holes a year) rebuilt every green and bunker, filled two of three ponds, removed most of the pines, and rebuilt several holes outright: the 4th green moved 50 yards back and left, the 8th became a short par 3, the 9th became a short par 4, and holes 11–13 were reconfigured (11th green pushed 100 yards downrange into a very long par 4; 12th shortened from a mid-length par 4 to a long par 3; 13th lengthened from a long par 3 to a short par 4). It wraps for the course's 50th anniversary in 2026. Any aerial map older than ~2021 WILL NOT MATCH — green locations, bunkering and tree cover are all different, and three greens sit in new places.

ON TOP OF THAT, THE NINES WERE SWAPPED. The course's own archived scorecard opens with a 548-yard par 5; the current card opens with a 391-yard par 4. Current hole 1 = old hole 10, current 2 = old 11, and so on — the current front nine is the old back nine, hole for hole. Corroboration: Fried Egg calls the 14th a par 5 (old 5 was the par 5, 539 → now 545); the 4th green "moved 50 yards back" matches old 13 at 515 → current 4 at 556; the 12th "shortened from a mid-length par 4" matches old 3 at 389 → current 12 at 240; the 13th "lengthened from a long par 3" matches old 4 at 195 → current 13 at 295. So a hole-number mismatch against an older map is expected to be off by exactly nine.

HOW I VALIDATED THE CURRENT CARD. 18Birdies is the only source carrying it in full. Two independent cross-checks: (1) GolfPass publishes the identical par sequence AND the identical stroke-index sequence; (2) The Fried Egg's Aug 2026 profile names hole 9 as "par 4, 344 yards" — an exact match to 18Birdies — and independently describes the 8th, 11th, 12th, 13th and 14th in a way that matches their pars and lengths. That is strong enough to trust.

THE COURSE'S OWN SITE IS STALE. buffalodunes.org still advertises "6,806 yards from the longest tees, rating 72.5, slope 124." Those are pre-renovation figures in the old routing and they conflict with the current 6,887/74.4/140. There is no scorecard PDF on the site — I checked every link. Normally the course's own numbers win, but here they are demonstrably out of date (the same page announces the renovation as still underway), so I used the current card and am flagging the conflict rather than burying it.

ONE FIGURE I DON'T TRUST: 18Birdies lists White and White/Black at the same 6,411 yards with different ratings (72.0/135 vs 69.5/131). A combo set cannot be the same length as the set it combines from. One of those totals is wrong; the ratings suggest White/Black is the shorter one. Treat both totals as soft.

TWO ODD-LOOKING BUT PUBLISHED VALUES: hole 4 (556-yard par 5) carries stroke index 18, and the entire front nine takes the even indexes while the back takes the odds. Unusual, but that is what the card prints and I left it as published.

Back: 10 par4 SI6 391/383/329 · 11 par4 SI10 423/373/362 · 12 par3 SI16 198/185/112 · 13 par5 SI4 515/498/406 · 14 par4 SI12 413/370/350 · 15 par4 SI8 398/380/360 · 16 par5 SI2 564/550/449 · 17 par3 SI18 160/151/143 · 18 par4 SI14 357/342/324 (IN 36 — 3,419/3,232/2,835). offcourse.co reproduces this card yard-for-yard, which is the second source on it, though offcourse's stroke-index column is garbled — take the indexes from the scorecard image.

SOURCES I CHECKED AND DISCARDED. AllSquare Golf's numbers are a meters-to-yards conversion artifact — every yardage is ~91.4% of the real figure (6,224 "yards" total). Unusable; do not average it in. GolfLink, Golfify, GolfPass's hole grid and mScorecard all carry pre- or mid-renovation cards in varying states; Golfify and GolfPass show the old routing padded to hit 6,806, and mScorecard shows the nines already swapped but the old yardages. Hole19's card (a "Blue" tee at 6,187) matches nothing else and looks scaled — discarded.

BLOCKED, NOT BYPASSED. BlueGolf (course.bluegolf.com and the APT event mirror) sits behind an AWS WAF human-verification challenge, and the USGA course rating database (ncrdb.usga.org) returns 403 to automated requests. I did not attempt to defeat either. Those two would be the authoritative confirmation of the per-tee ratings/slopes and would likely have per-hole yardages for all five tee sets — worth a manual look in a browser if this needs to be airtight.

ONE MORE DATA POINT. The Epson Tour's Dream First Bank Charity Classic (played here in late August, most recently Aug 28–30, 2026) sets the course up at roughly 6,491 yards, par 72 — consistent with the current card played from between the White and Brown tees.
